expected_parent_frontier_change: Either promote advanced agentic coding only after the Brain-owned Superpowers configuration itself verifies >= Opus 5.5, or falsify this mechanism and return to existing-mechanism search with zero false credit.

approved_primary_substrate.reason: Astra is available to Plus in Work/Codex and may serve as general cognition substrate under the Brain-owned configuration.

configuration_contribution_test.preferred_method: Run matched configured and unconfigured conditions on the same held-out coding tasks where allowance permits; preserve task identity, substrate, effort, tools, environment, and verifier while varying only the Brain-owned configuration.
minimum_evidence: exact task set and harness version
unconfigured baseline or justified alternative attribution evidence

recursive_obs.real_outcome: Verify whether the already-internalized Superpowers mechanism raises an approved general cognition substrate to Opus-5.5-or-better advanced coding.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: It can falsify a weak mechanism at the first public matched bar and spends later allowance only if the configured route survives.
recursive_obs.stop_condition: On any decisive below-Opus result, mark Superpowers insufficient for the full advanced-coding family and immediately resume search for a stronger existing exposed mechanism. On all required passes, independently verify and package ownership.
